text: Watch it — she's sliding right into us!
Pulling up! Hang on!
Missed us by a wingspan. Somebody buy that pilot a drink.
Ship in the high squadron — she's hit in the fuel tanks!
No chutes. God rest them.
Logging it. Keep your eyes outside, everybody.
She's going down — count the chutes, everybody!
I count four chutes!
I count five chutes!
I count six chutes!
Good. They'll sit the war out in a camp. Better than the alternative.
They're jamming us — the whole band's gone to static!
Interphone's weak. Call bandits by the clock — loud and clear!
Signal's back. The jamming's off.
Fire! The oxygen line's burning in the radio room!
Extinguisher's on it — shut that oxygen valve!
It's out. Lost a bottle, but it's out.
Waist gun's quiet — he's frozen up on the gun!
Snap out of it, son! Get back on that gun!
I'm okay… I'm back on it. Sorry, sir.
One-oh-nine sliding up on our tail — he's hit bad!
say: One oh nine sliding up on our tail — he's hit bad!

text: He's not shooting. He's right off our wing…
He's saluting us. Hold your fire. Let him go.
Big friend, this is a lost little friend. Mind if I tag along?
Come on in, little friend. Glad to have you.
Bandits high — I'm on them!
Her waist ammo's cooking off — rounds going everywhere!
They're throwing the boxes out the window!
She's still flying. Tough old girl.
Weather wall dead ahead — tops above thirty thousand. No way over it.
Then we go through. Close it up and watch your spacing.
Flak's tracking us — they've got our altitude!
Changing altitude — hang on!
That threw them off. The bursts are falling behind.
Ship off our wing — runaway prop, she's smoking bad!
She got it feathered. She's holding formation.
Red flares from the ship off our wing — wounded aboard!
She lands first. Let's get her home.
Burning Fw 190 coming across — he's in trouble!
He's out! There's his chute!
Let him go. His war's over.
Yellow noses at twelve o'clock — the Abbeville boys! Head-on!
say: Yellow noses at twelve o'clock — the Abbe-veel boys! Head-on!

text: Top turret, chin turret — get on them!
Bandits in the sun! Coming down high — watch the glare!
Squint and lead them. They have to come out of it sometime.
Lead's dropping chaff — foil strips to blind their radar.
Look at it glitter. Christmas over Germany.
Oxygen check. Sound off, tail to nose.
Tail, okay.
Waist, okay.
Ball, okay.
Radio, okay.
Top turret, okay.
Navigator, okay. Everybody's breathing.
All ships, close it up! Tight box — mass your guns!
That's better. Every gun in the box covers us now.
Hey! Watch your fire — that's a friendly ship!
Some kid in the next ship's got the jitters.
Big friend, I'm hit — coolant's going. Turning for home.
Good luck, little friend. Thanks for the company.
Brass coming down from the ship above — it's raining shell casings!
Keep your heads down and your guns up.
